from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCapitalEntry(BaseModel):
    """A record of share capital for a single fiscal year reported in one document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year end associated with the report (e.g., '2019', '2020')")
    shares_outstanding: float = Field(description="The number of common shares outstanding reported for this year")
    stock_split_info: str = Field(description="Details about any stock splits approved or applied (e.g., '3-for-1', 'retroactive adjustment')")
    issuance_details: str = Field(description="Brief reason for change in shares (e.g., 'debt settlement', 'private placement')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_capital_data: list[ShareCapitalEntry]
